# AF 第十章 原文（重制基线）

## Chapter 10

[P01] Years passed. The animals' short lives flew by. Soon no one remembered the old days before the uprising（起义）, except Clover, Benjamin, Moses the raven, and some pigs; but Muriel, Bluebell, Jessie, and Pincher were dead. Muriel, Bluebell, Jessie, and Pincher were dead. Jones too was dead. Snowball was forgotten. Boxer was forgotten, except by a few. Clover was an old stout（肥胖的） mare（母马） now, stiff and with rheumy eyes. She was two years past the retiring（退休） age, but no animal had ever retired（退休的）.

[P02] People stopped talking about the corner for old animals long ago. Napoleon was now a grown boar（公猪） of twenty-four stone（石头）. Squealer was so fat that he could hardly see. Only old Benjamin was much the same, but greyer near his nose, and since Boxer died, sad and quiet. There were more animals now, though not as many as expected. Many had been born who only knew the uprising as a dim（昏暗的） story. Others had been bought and had never heard of it.

[P03] The farm now had three horses besides Clover. They were strong and good workers, but very stupid. None could learn the alphabet（字母表） past the letter B. They believed everything told about the uprising and Animalism（动物主义）, especially from Clover, whom they respected like a parent. But it was doubtful（怀疑的） if they understood much. Many animals were born to whom the uprising was only a dim story. The farm was richer and better organised.
